X Treme Apparel LLC operates from Phoenix, Arizona, as a manufacturer specializing in decorated apparel. The company does not publicly disclose its founding date, ownership structure, or the names of its founders, so the origins of the business remain unspecified in available records.

The company's core offering is the production of decorated apparel, supplemented by in-house graphic design services that assist customers with artwork preparation. Details about the specific decoration techniques employed—such as screen printing, embroidery, or heat transfer—are not provided, nor are figures for facility size, employee headcount, or annual production volumes.

While the company does not enumerate the industries it serves, decorated apparel manufacturers typically supply businesses, organizations, and events requiring branded clothing. No specific customer names or case studies are referenced in the available information.

X Treme Apparel states that it differentiates itself through attention to detail, product quality, and quick turnaround times, positioning these factors as the foundation of its service commitment.
